name: Vargas Turbo Technologies VTT B58 GC Turbocharger Upgrade VTT-B58-GC-2 for 2020 Toyota GR Supra 3.0 (2-Port Manifold)
fitment: 2020 Toyota GR Supra 3.0 (A90, B58 engine with the 2-port exhaust manifold). Does not fit 2021-and-later GR Supra 3.0 (6-port manifold), which uses VTT-B58-GC-3; confirm the manifold port count on your engine
description:
Vargas Turbo Technologies VTT B58 GC Turbocharger Upgrade VTT-B58-GC-2 for 2020 Toyota GR Supra 3.0 (2-Port Manifold)

VTT "GC" turbocharger upgrade for the B58 engine with the 2-port exhaust manifold, made from new castings (not a rebuilt factory turbocharger). Aftermarket part; not made or warranted by Toyota.

Specifications

Manufacturer: Vargas Turbo Technologies (VTT)
Manufacturer part number: VTT-B58-GC-2 (also listed as B58TU2GC)
Engine: B58 3.0L inline-6 turbo, 2-port exhaust manifold
Supported power (manufacturer): stock to 600 WHP
Construction (manufacturer): 100% new castings; GC is the cold side and bearing housing (the GC+ is the complete unit, sold separately)
Turbine wheel: 9-blade Mar-M 246
Compressor wheel: 9-blade point-milled
Inlet: 3 in. turbocharger inlet
Connections: factory oil, water, downpipe and charge pipe connections
Core charge: none; the unit is sold outright
Manufacturer warranty: 12 months, unlimited mileage (per VTT)
Condition: New

In the box (per the manufacturer)

1 VTT B58 "GC" turbocharger
1 VTT 3 in. to 4 in. silicone inlet elbow with adapters for the factory connections
1 3 in. hose clamp for the inlet elbow
1 optional 4 in. connector for the inlet elbow, for use with the stock airbox

Toyota fitment

2020 Toyota GR Supra 3.0 (A90, B58 engine with the 2-port exhaust manifold). Does not fit 2021-and-later GR Supra 3.0 (6-port manifold), which uses VTT-B58-GC-3; confirm the manifold port count on your engine.

Notes

Install kit, fuel system upgrades and an engine tune are not included. VTT recommends pairing the upgrade with a tune and supporting parts.
For off-road / competition use; check emissions rules in your state before installing.

Shipping
Ships within the United States only.

name: GReddy Turbo Kit TD06SH-25G 10cm² (Actuator Type) 11510033 for 1993–1997 Toyota Supra Turbo (JZA80, 2JZ-GTE)
fitment: 1993–1997 Toyota Supra Turbo (JZA80, 2JZ-GTE twin-turbo, non-VVT-i). GReddy lists the JZA80 2JZ-GTE built 1993.05–1997.08; not for the 1998 VVT-i engine or the non-turbo 2JZ-GE
description:
GReddy Turbo Kit TD06SH-25G 10cm² (Actuator Type) 11510033 for 1993–1997 Toyota Supra Turbo (JZA80, 2JZ-GTE)

GReddy single-turbo kit for the JZA80 Supra's 2JZ-GTE that replaces the factory twin turbochargers, using the factory exhaust manifold through a turbine adapter. Aftermarket part; not made or warranted by Toyota.

Specifications

Manufacturer: GReddy Performance Products
Manufacturer part number: 11510033
Turbocharger: TD06SH-25G, 10 cm² turbine housing, GReddy reinforced actuator (internal wastegate)
Manifold: uses the factory exhaust manifold (adapter type)
Setting (manufacturer): boost 0.85 kg/cm² = approx. 370 PS, with the factory intercooler layout and injectors
Engine: 2JZ-GTE (non-VVT-i)
Condition: New

In the box (per the manufacturer)

Turbocharger body
Turbine adapter
Outlet pipe
Suction pipe
Airinx M80 air filter
Oil pressure hose
Short parts set

Toyota fitment

1993–1997 Toyota Supra Turbo (JZA80, 2JZ-GTE twin-turbo, non-VVT-i). GReddy lists the JZA80 2JZ-GTE built 1993.05–1997.08; not for the 1998 VVT-i engine or the non-turbo 2JZ-GE.

Notes

Not compatible with VVT-i 2JZ-GTE engines (the 1998 US Supra Turbo). The factory catalyst can be retained only with the factory exhaust manifold.
Engine management changes and tuning are not included. For off-road / competition use; check emissions rules in your state before installing.

Shipping
Ships within the United States only.

T78-29D turbocharger (14 cm²)
Stainless exhaust manifold (42.7 mm)
